title: Ex-Infosys veteran’s enterprise AI startup Aiden raises $32 million from A91 Partners
summary: Enterprise AI startup Aiden raises $32 million in funding led by A91 Partners
detailed: Srinivas Kamadi spent more than two decades at Infosys before leaving in 2023 to set up Aiden AI. He said the venture was born out of conversations with enterprise clients who wanted to accelerate digital transformation but often found projects constrained by costs and competing business priorities.
